description: PAID $0.10 via x402 (USDC micropayment over HTTP 402). Returns a set of practitioner-written positive affirmations matched to a specific pregnancy or postpartum stage. Set 'stage' to one of: 't1-t2' (first/second trimester), 't3' (third trimester), 'labour', 'caesarean', 'postpartum', or 'identity' (matrescence / becoming-a-mother). If omitted or unmatched, the first set is returned. Set 'lang' to 'en' (default) or 'hu'. Returns the id, title, stage, the list of affirmation lines, and a verification block.

stage.description: Target stage: 't1-t2', 't3', 'labour', 'caesarean', 'postpartum', or 'identity'. Optional; first set returned if omitted.

name: get_affirmations
